# Income Statement Line Items - Extraction Skill

## Goal

Extract the requested income statement line items for the requested periods, reconciled to the reported totals, as a single structured output.

Checklist:
1. [ ] Read docs/manifest.json
2. [ ] Convert PDFs to text
3. [ ] Locate income statement, notes, cash flow
4. [ ] Cross-check dates vs assessment_year
5. [ ] View statement pages as images
6. [ ] Write out/is-01-face-lines.json
7. [ ] Write out/is-02-routing.json
8. [ ] Write out/is-03-*.json sections
9. [ ] Write out/is-04-reconciliation.json
10. [ ] Self-checks and return JSON
